title: CobbleRealms
description: A Cobblemon survival network, three connected realms, weekly tournaments, and a community building it together.
body: A Cobblemon survival network where Pokemon roam wild across three connected realms. Catch a starter at spawn, claim land in Realm 1 or Realm 2, build your dream base, and team up with trainers from around the world. Whether you're here to grind shinies, run gym battles with friends, or just vibe in the Pokemart, there's a corner of the ocean for you.
